title: Thalidomide Maintenance Treatment in DLBCL
brief_summary: This is a randomized, multi-center,phase III study to evaluate the ability of thalidomide maintenance therapy to prolong relapse-free survival in diffuse large B cell lymphoma(DLBCL).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* NCCN-IPI\>1,
* Known IPI, cell of origin and DHL at time of diagnosis,
* Negative pregnancy test,
* Men must agree not to father a child during the therapy,
* 6 to 8 cycles R-CHOP/like, total of 8 x Rituximab,
* CR, CRu

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transformed lymphoma,
* Secondary malignancy,
* HIV positive,
* Evidence of CNS involvement,
* Cardiac dysfunction (systolic ejection fraction \<50%),
* Creatinine \> 2.0 mg/dl
